definition: Coverage is the share of tracked in-repository dependency manifest roots that are included in a canonical clean-room SBOM generator with evidence files present. It is not a claim about deployable image, GitHub Actions secret, host secret, or remote runtime coverage.
boundaries: Tracked dependency manifests are discovered from Git, not from a hand-maintained denominator.
Node workspace coverage requires a matching pnpm-lock.yaml importer and the canonical Node CycloneDX/SPDX pair.
Dedicated manifests require their declared canonical CycloneDX/SPDX pair.
Known gaps are explicit and fail closed if a new unlisted gap appears or an obsolete gap remains configured.
This scope does not cover OS packages in built images, GitHub Actions secrets, REG.RU host secrets, or other remote runtime state.
